# Managed instances must terminate on real compiler-generated ownership checks.
# Only the small assembly fixture injects foreign pointers into typed slots;
# normal SDK dispatch transfers bytes instead.
[short] skip
[compiler:gccgo] skip
[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip

go build -o fault.exe ./host
exec ./fault.exe
stdout -count=2 '^managed read terminated$'
stdout -count=2 '^managed write terminated$'
stdout -count=2 '^managed publication terminated$'
stdout '^host alive$'

[race] go build -race -o fault-race.exe ./host
[race] exec ./fault-race.exe
[race] stdout -count=2 '^managed read terminated$'
[race] stdout -count=2 '^managed write terminated$'
[race] stdout -count=2 '^managed publication terminated$'
[race] stdout '^host alive$'

# External modules cannot inherit the GOROOT runtime namespace exemption.
go run ./rename
go mod edit -module=runtime/rogue
go build -o namespaced$GOEXE ./host
exec ./namespaced$GOEXE
stdout -count=2 '^managed read terminated$'
stdout -count=2 '^managed write terminated$'
stdout -count=2 '^managed publication terminated$'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/isolatefault

go 1.26
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs

import "example.org/isolatefault/dispatch"

//go:isolate
func Probe(p *int, mode int) {
    defer func() {
        _ = recover()
        panic("application recover/defer ran after ownership violation")
    }()
    switch mode {
    case 0: dispatch.Use(*p)
    case 1: *p = 9
    case 2:
        slot := new(*int)
        *slot = p
        dispatch.Keep(slot)
    }
}
-- dispatch/dispatch.go --
package dispatch

import (
    "isolate"
    "encoding/binary"
 )
func inject(dst **int, src uintptr)

// Instrumented helpers force values to escape without hiding the operation
// inside Probe. Only inject bypasses checks, as an explicit assembly fixture.
var sink **int

//go:noinline
func Keep(p **int) { sink = p }

//go:noinline
func Use(n int) {}

func Program(h isolate.Handle) isolate.Program {
    // The small assembly fixture injects the deliberately invalid reference.
    // Compulsory Go checks would correctly reject a host-captured closure or
    // ordinary publication before reaching the operation being tested.
    return h.ProgramWithHandle(func(h isolate.Handle) {
        request, err := isolate.Call(1, nil)
        if err != nil { panic(err) }
        address := uintptr(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(request))
        mode := int(request[8])
        err = h.Invoke(func(v ...isolate.Value) error {
            inject(v[0].Pointer.(**int), address)
            *v[1].Pointer.(*int) = mode
            return nil
        }, func(...isolate.Value) error { return nil })
        panic(err) // Any return means containment failed.
    })
}
-- host/main.go --
package main

import (
    "context"
    "encoding/binary"
    "unsafe"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "isolate"
    "time"

    "example.org/isolatefault/dispatch"
    "example.org/isolatefault/jobs"
)

//go:noinline
func allocate() *int { return new(int) }

func main() {
    handle, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Probe)
    if !ok { panic("missing marked function") }
    now := time.Date(2025, time.January, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
    foreign := allocate()
    *foreign = 7
    names := []string{"read", "write", "publication"}
    reasons := []string{"isolate: read from foreign heap", "isolate: write to foreign heap", "isolate: foreign heap reference publication"}
    for _, deterministic := range []bool{false, true} {
        for mode, name := range names {
            i, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: dispatch.Program(handle), Deterministic: deterministic, InitialTime: &now, TimerOp: 1})
            if err != nil { panic(err) }
            if err := i.Start(); err != nil { panic(err) }
            request := make([]byte, 9)
            binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(request, uint64(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(foreign))))
            request[8] = byte(mode)
            select {
            case command := <-i.Commands(): command.Reply(request, nil)
            case <-i.Done(): panic(i.Wait())
            }
            var fault *isolate.OwnershipError
            if err := i.Wait(); !errors.As(err, &fault) || fault.Reason != reasons[mode] { panic(fmt.Sprintf("wrong fault: %v", err)) }
            ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
            err = i.Kill(ctx)
            cancel()
            if err != nil { panic(err) }
            if err := i.Start(); err == nil { panic("faulted instance restarted") }
            if *foreign != 7 { panic("foreign data changed") }
            fmt.Println("managed", name, "terminated")
        }
    }
    fmt.Println("host alive")
}

-- dispatch/inject_amd64.s --
#include "textflag.h"
TEXT ·inject(SB),NOSPLIT,$0-16
    MOVQ dst+0(FP), AX
    MOVQ src+8(FP), BX
    MOVQ BX, (AX)
    RET
-- dispatch/inject_arm64.s --
#include "textflag.h"
TEXT ·inject(SB),NOSPLIT,$0-16
    MOVD dst+0(FP), R0
    MOVD src+8(FP), R1
    MOVD R1, (R0)
    RET

-- rename/main.go --
package main
import ("os"; "strings")
func main() {
 for _, path := range []string{"jobs/jobs.go","host/main.go"} {
  data,err := os.ReadFile(path); if err != nil { panic(err) }
  data = []byte(strings.ReplaceAll(string(data),"example.org/isolatefault","runtime/rogue"))
  if err := os.WriteFile(path,data,0600); err != nil { panic(err) }
 }
}
